planDoc: Channel Booster Blueprint (claude.ai artifact, 2026-09-23), section 'The plan', days 3-7; the Desk theme follows the owner's answer 4 (dark Grok-style)

verdict.nbcliReport: NBCLI preview was not run in this session. The plan's items come from the Blueprint, whose findings were adversarially verified and red-teamed before publication.

phases.title: Cut the ties
phases.goal: A real node bin, declared runtime dependencies, the playbook built in, one workspace folder per channel, workflow stages in-process, and every old runbook still working.

gates.title: Host repo verify: typecheck, every test, builds, release check
Packed bin from an empty folder: node shebang, full doctrine, workspace-contained writes
Split rehearsal: the booster installs and verifies alone in the private repo's layout

phases.title: Dark Grok-style Desk
phases.goal: The Desk opens dark and Grok-style by default in every host theme, with a light option, and the live Desk artifact carries the merged build.

gates.title: Host repo verify after the Desk change
Desk runtime journey: dark default, light option, gates, zero requests, phone layout, contrast

phases.title: Separate into the private repo
phases.goal: Navigata1/channel-booster (private) holds the booster with its history in the rehearsed layout, verifies from a fresh clone, and merges through the gates workflow.

gates.title: Fresh clone verify in the new repo
History carried, no Grok UI code

budget.notes: Nominal cap: this session does not meter spend in dollars. P2 waits on the owner creating the empty private repo.

conditions: Owner granted merge authority in chat on 2026-09-24: merge PRs from here on once their gates pass
